title: Review a document with others
intro: A scripted run with invented data. Other participants are scripted too. Press Next, or use the controls where the script waits for you.

steps.pm: I have finished the Allowances PRD. Help me review it.

steps.agent: I read it end to end. It is in good shape. I left two comments in the document, and one of them needs you.

comment.on: It applies from the next cycle.
comment.text: This contradicts 3.3, which says a changed amount applies right away. Which one is right?

comment.on: no more than a minute old
comment.text: Worth stating what the card user sees when the amount cannot be refreshed.

steps.pm: 3.3 is right. The FAQ is out of date.

comment.resolve: It applies from the next cycle.

steps.agent: Resolved, and I started a findings list in the canvas. Before this goes wider, two people usually have views on a card feature. Who should I call in?

steps.hint: Pick who to call in, press Call them in, then Send.

steps.ask: Review the Allowances PRD for regulatory, conduct and fraud risk. Add findings to the shared list.

steps.says: Reading sections 4 and 7 against the disclosure, minors and retention policies. I will comment in the document and list findings as I go.

comment.on: These are counted against the allowance but not blocked.
comment.text: High. A parent will read an allowance as a cap. This sentence is where that stops being true. See F-01.
Whose consent? The cardholder's and the minor's are different records. See F-03.

steps.says: Four findings, one High. Nothing blocks sign-off if F-01 becomes a launch gate. I need one answer from you to close F-03:

steps.hint: Answer Risk Review's question, then Send.

patch.answer: The cardholder, as parent or guardian

steps.says: Recorded on F-03. No blockers from Risk. I will look again when the 7.3 wording exists.
steps.end_call: 4 findings, 1 High. No blockers once F-01 is a launch gate.

steps.agent: Risk is done. Mara next, on the card user's experience. An agent is standing in for her today, working from her notes.

steps.ask: Look at section 5 of the Allowances PRD from the card user's side. Add findings to the shared list.

steps.says: Hi! Section 5 is close. My worry is the decline moment. A teenager at a till will not wait ten seconds, and five of the eight families I spoke to in spring said as much.

comment.text: Too slow at a till. Three seconds, and tell them what to do next. See F-05.

steps.says: Three from me. One question back: if I can only keep one of the two alerts in 5.4 and 6.3, which would you keep?
steps.hint: Type a reply to Mara and press Send.

steps.says: That works. I would cut 5.4 from launch then, and I have noted it on F-07.
steps.end_call: 3 findings, 1 High. Suggests cutting 5.4 from launch.

steps.agent: Both reviews are in. Eight findings from three of us, two High. Everything is in one list, with who raised what.
Open any finding to read it, accept it or push back. Pushing back goes to whoever raised it.
steps.hint: Try it in the canvas: open F-05 and accept it, or push back on F-06. Then Send.

steps.agent: Done. When you are ready, I can apply the accepted findings to the PRD as suggested edits.
